_OPEN_CODE_READ_VERSION = "1.18.25"
_OPEN_CODE_READ_OFFSET = 100
_OPEN_CODE_READ_LIMIT = 5
_OMO_HASHLINE_VERSION = "5.0.0-beta.21"
_OMO_HASHLINE_SOURCE_REVISION = "a17b91cdc210a24a86accf51c41e57b99e8aced7"
_OMO_READ_PARITY_VECTOR = (
    pytest.param(
        100,
        "alpha",
        "100: alpha",
        "100#JN|alpha",
        "JN",
        id="significant-line-number",
    ),
    pytest.param(
        100,
        "}",
        "100: }",
        "100#MN|}",
        "MN",
        id="non-significant-line-number-100",
    ),
    pytest.param(
        101,
        "}",
        "101: }",
        "101#YK|}",
        "YK",
        id="non-significant-line-number-101",
    ),
    pytest.param(
        102,
        "  alpha  ",
        "102:   alpha  ",
        "102#NZ|  alpha  ",
        "JN",
        id="leading-and-trailing-whitespace",
    ),
    pytest.param(
        103,
        "alpha\r",
        "103: alpha\r",
        "103#JN|alpha\r",
        "JN",
        id="carriage-return-removal",
    ),
    pytest.param(
        104,
        "  al pha  ",
        "104:   al pha  ",
        "104#YB|  al pha  ",
        "JN",
        id="legacy-whitespace-validation",
    ),
)
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("line_number", "content", "displayed", "native", "legacy_hash"),
    _OMO_READ_PARITY_VECTOR,
)
def test_omo_read_enhancer_replay_matches_slopgate_hashline_validation(
    line_number: int,
    content: str,
    displayed: str,
    native: str,
    legacy_hash: str,
) -> None:
    current_hash = line_hash(line_number, content)

    assert {
        "opencode_version": _OPEN_CODE_READ_VERSION,
        "offset": _OPEN_CODE_READ_OFFSET,
        "limit": _OPEN_CODE_READ_LIMIT,
        "omo_version": _OMO_HASHLINE_VERSION,
        "omo_source_revision": _OMO_HASHLINE_SOURCE_REVISION,
        "displayed": displayed,
        "native": native,
        "slopgate_current": f"{line_number}#{current_hash}|{content}",
    } == {
        "opencode_version": _OPEN_CODE_READ_VERSION,
        "offset": _OPEN_CODE_READ_OFFSET,
        "limit": _OPEN_CODE_READ_LIMIT,
        "omo_version": _OMO_HASHLINE_VERSION,
        "omo_source_revision": _OMO_HASHLINE_SOURCE_REVISION,
        "displayed": f"{line_number}: {content}",
        "native": f"{line_number}#{current_hash}|{content}",
        "slopgate_current": f"{line_number}#{current_hash}|{content}",
    }

    legacy_result = project_hashline_edits(
        content,
        [{"op": "replace", "pos": f"1#{legacy_hash}", "lines": ["updated"]}],
    )
    assert legacy_result.content == "updated"
